## Design Settings » Homepage » Primary & Secondary Hero Content


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000106039


## Primary Hero Content


These settings control the Main Title Text and Sub-Title Text displayed on the homepage of the website.


## Visual Guide of the Primary Hero Content



### 1. Content Area Width


This setting controls the width used by the Primary Hero Content on the homepage of the website.


### 2. Content Alignment


This setting controls the location of the message; the options are Left, Right, and Center

Left

Right

Center


### 3. Font Family


This setting controls the Font Family for the entire Primary Hero Content


### 4. Main Title Text


This is the field where to type the Main Title Text for the website


### 5. Color


This setting controls the color of the Main Title Text for the website.


### 6. Size


This setting controls the size of the Main Title Text for the website.


### 7. Weight


This setting controls the weight of the Main Title Text for the website; the options are Light, Normal, Bold, and Extra Bold.


### 8. Align


This setting controls the location of the Main Title Text for the website; the options are Left, Right and Center.


### 9. Bottom Spacing (padding)


This setting controls the amount of empty space added between the Main Title Text and Sub-Title Text.


### 10. Text Shadow


This setting adds a shadow effect behind text to make it stand out or create a stylistic look.


### 11. Sub-Title Text


This is the field where to type the Sub-Title Text for the website


### 12. Color


This setting controls the color of the Sub- Title Text for the website.


### 13. Size


This setting controls the size of the Sub- Title Text for the website.


### 14. Align


This setting controls the location of the Sub- Title Text for the website; the options are Left, Right and Center.


### 15. Weight


This setting controls the weight of the Sub- Title Text for the website; the options are Light, Normal, Bold, and Extra Bold.


### IMPORTANT NOTE


If Primary Content Width is under 100% and aligned left or right, the remaining hero area can be used for Secondary Hero Content to display an image, video, or left blank.


## Secondary Hero Content (optional)


These settings control the Main Title Text and Sub-Title Text displayed on the homepage of the website.


## Visual Guide of the Primary Hero Content



### 1. Froala Editor


In this section, text, images, or videos can be added to display next to the Primary Hero Content.


### 2. Mobile View


This setting controls whether the content shows on Mobile View or not.

Hide on Mobile

Show on Mobile
